notes.title: HordeCore Update v1.09
Hotfix v1.08
Hotfix v1.07
notes.notes:
Hi! 

We just released a new hotfix.

We had a recurring issue in multiplayer. Joining a server that is already in progress would result in the joining player never starting to see the spawns.

Now when a player joins a server that is already in progress, we force that player's spawns to activate on their own after a fixed number of seconds. This completely solves the issue for the rest of the match.

[b]Other changes[/b]:

- Adjusted the bullet shooting origin point's rotation on Engineer classes when they have no weapon equipped, because we noticed that on multiplayer their bullets would sometimes go higher than they were being aimed.

Now it is always aiming forward from the pistol instead of rotating with the rest of the animation, which prevents this deviation. This adjustment is strictly done in the animation itself.

notes.title: Q&A With Developers: New Skill Effects, Recent Progress and More!
notes.notes:
Hello, survivors!

Recently we’ve released a brand new Playtest for HordeCore! For this occasion, we’ve prepared a special Q&A blog with our developers to shed light on recent events around the game and tell you more about what’s next for HordeCore!

Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/5a718f50c0de34e0e213d1fb9af975d6b03c83f0.jpg[/img]

[b]How’s the team doing in general?[/b]
We're doing great, thanks for asking!

As we get closer and closer to revealing our release date, we're all growing very anxious to unveil what we've been working on for the past few months, and it's really exciting to know that more people will get to enjoy the world we're creating pretty soon.

[b]What have you been focused on for the last few months?[/b]
It's been quite a ride, and we've had no shortage of things to do while getting our wastelands ready for new adventurers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/a57ddc38c206ed3372e56a967ba38bd55238e7b1.gif[/img]

From bug squishing to creating awesome new weapons, new abilities, new places to explore, new threats to overcome, a couple of cool new UI features, and a myriad of funny hats, we're doing our best to ensure everyone can have a blast splattering hordeling brains over their favorite characters.

[b]These new effects look cool - tell us more about them![/b]
We think so too!

An important part of the challenge in HordeCore is to constantly overcome the odds of being outnumbered by all kinds of threats, so we wanted to make sure there was some "oomph" to the player's abilities and weapons while they're doing so, without letting it become too overwhelming to control. We feel like we struck a good balance, and we're eager to hear what our players think - and to continue to improve on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/dd794ee9113745bccb3244bf6c5ccc026cbb33f6.gif[/img]

[b]Are you planning to add more classes?[/b]
Oh, definitely!

We want to give the player the opportunity to explore our challenges with as many different playstyle combinations as they can think of, and that includes loot, character classes, and even abilities.

That's also the reason why you're not restricted to the same abilities in every class, in fact, one of our favorite additions to the game was the Ability Modifier system, which lets you modify your active skills way beyond their default behavior, to the point where you could have a full squad of Survivors with the same class but different abilities on all of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/b1c4d2a4e424c38518aad0755caa3ceada789dc1.png[/img]

We have quite a few tricks under our sleeves that we can't wait to reveal, but you'll hear more about them in due time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/4018a24b1e93e3e003f3b0f8f0bcc02c30f36edd.gif[/img]

[b]If you could implement any feature with a flick of a finger, what would it be? [/b]
That's easy, pet costumes!

Everyone in the team feels very strongly about the idea of slaying hordes of enemies alongside our favorite pet in a shark costume! But don't get us talking about it or we'll end up taking longer to finish the game because we're too busy designing dog-sized outfits.

[b]Last, but not least — how have you spent the Holidays?[/b]
With the current events, we're all (unfortunately) aware of, we made sure to spend some time with those we love, be it physically, digitally, or on the other side of a phone call.

We also caught up on our favorite games, books, or shows, and we took some time off to reflect on the future of HordeCore, as well as everything we wish to accomplish on what we're hoping will be a very exciting year!

HordeCore will be coming out in 2022 on PC and other platforms. Wishlist and stay tuned for our upcoming announcements!  Thank you for reading and stay safe!

notes.title: Introducing Version 0.19.2.0 - Huge Content Update & Halloween Event!
notes.notes:
The spooky season has come to HordeCore (yes, even spookier than before)! Training Grounds just got a huge update with many new features!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421960/HordeCore_Training_Ground/

This patch includes not only our favorite seasonal event — Halloween —  but also a massive content update that reflects how far we've come with the development of HordeCore in the past months. The list is HUGE, so let’s dig into it!

[b]CONTENT[/b]
A strange green fog has appeared throughout the wastelands, and there are rumors of Survivors being taken away by red-hooded figures wearing unusual masks. We don’t know who they are but are advising everyone to fire on sight — just to be sure it’s not Hordelings playing tricks on us. After all, who wants to become their treat?
[list]
[*] Dozens of new weapons, armor, and masks can now be crafted and looted throughout the wastelands.
[*] Crafting improvements! Tons of new crafting recipes are now available to try, and there's a lot more to unlock through your Skill Tree.
[*] New Salvaging system! You can now deconstruct any weapon or armor into useful crafting materials, anywhere, anytime.
[*] New Healing system! Higher risks, higher rewards - you will now need to hold your healing key while your character heals, but it will also partially heal your entire party!
[*] Carve your own path through the wastelands! Our new Map system allows you to make meaningful decisions while progressing through the story. 
[*] The new map means brand new side-quests and missions! Now you have lots of new ways to challenge yourself while you hunt for the loot you need.
[*] Skill Modifiers —  a new way to customize your Survivors' fighting skills! You can now combine powerful modifiers that will drastically change any Survivor's special ability, with LOTS of possible combinations available. Do you like your Hordelings nice and crispy or blown to bits? 
[*] More control over your team! With our reworked Party Management and Party Control systems, you can now access any of your survivor's skills at the stroke of a button.
[*] Improved Skill Tree! A lot of unlockable passives have been re-worked to impact your play-through in more meaningful ways.
[*] Legendary Items! That's right, from the deadliest headgear to the fluffiest slippers, legendary items can now be looted... and crafted! 
[/list]
[b]CO-OP IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Be more than a ghost! Local co-op players can now pick up items and interact with the world around them.
[*] Your own inventory! Local co-op players can now open their own inventory with items and other fancy things!
[*] Saved progression! New local co-op players are included in your local saveslots, so you and your friends can continue to play together anytime.
[/list]
[b]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] New blood effects! The art of extermination has never been this beautiful;
[*] Several new ambient Particle effects;
[*] New bullets and damage effects on different weapons. It would be boring if a pistol and a rocket launcher had the same impact, right?
[*] Updated skill effects — new skill modifiers will drastically change their appearance;
[*] New healing effects;
[*] Improved scene transitions.
[/list]
[b]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
We’ll be honest — the old UI did the job, but it wasn’t the prettiest to look at. The good news is that we got rid of it and created a new one from scratch!
[list]
[*] We’ve completely reworked all menus;
[*] Completely redesigned in-game HUD;
[*] Reworked Crafting & Cooking tables;
[*] Created new Inventory UI & UX;
[*] Added new Party Management UI;
[*] HordeTactics got a new Deck Management system & UI;
[*] New Map Navigation & detailed level information.
[/list]
[b]PERFORMANCE[/b]
[list]
[*] Heavily improved performance across the board;
[*] Improved visual fidelity on lower graphical settings.
[/list]
Please let us know how do you like the new and improved HordeCore! If you don't want to miss big news, such as this update, - wishlist and follow us!

Thank you and have fun!

notes.title: Developer Diary: Three New Exciting Features and Your Questions!
notes.notes:
Hi! Recently we’ve been receiving lots of questions regarding the development process of HordeCore, so we’ve decided to answer the most popular ones! Without further ado, let’s start!

[h3][b]How did the game’s idea evolve through the development process?[/b][/h3]
Quite a lot, actually! We can’t stress the importance of player-driven feedback enough! While the core groundwork stayed the same throughout development, we’d say that the overall “fun-factor” has definitely been cranked up by a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/0d35a90c4e4e550be973f794b4ce08ef1f5ccda7.png[/img]

We had quite a few different phases of prototyping and iteration of our new ideas, and some of them ended up filling in the gaps that were brought to our attention by both our “closed doors'' testers, as well as by everyone who played our Prologue throughout the last few months.

It’s a really good sign that we’re already having a blast with a lot of these features internally, and we can’t wait to show them to everyone!

[h3][b]3 new planned features you are most excited about?[/b][/h3]
[b]Skill Modifiers![/b] We’re really excited to showcase what we’ve been working on and continue expanding on how we’re allowing the player to further customize their battle-hardened Survivors through skill modifications that can have bombastic results! No, we’re not talking about slight damage adjustments; every modification results in a completely new set of skills for every class. How exciting is that?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/242ed72d56a7ac758f64874437bed1fb307ea38f.gif[/img]

[b]Hordeling Modifiers![/b] We couldn’t let our Survivors have all the fun, so we’re also creating new subclasses for our green-skinned friends with very different aesthetics, resistances, and behaviors! We even saw one of them run away with a pack full of loot the other day.

[b]Our new Quest system![/b] Having exciting new ways to explore our Wastelands and face many different challenges with a combination of dynamically generated content and hand-crafted objectives seriously improve both first-hand enjoyment and replayability!

[h3][b]Where do we look for inspiration? How do we plan new stuff?[/b][/h3]
As a team, we’ve always preferred to work with a healthy dose of “free-flow” regarding new ideas and influences, meaning we’re very open to discuss the pros and cons of inserting (or, at least, prototyping) any new ideas that have the potential of improving the overall experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/4a0d63f9afaa45c03ef6c77896ef140c604ecc71.png[/img]

The balance between adding an extra workload versus said potential is something that definitely takes both the ability to follow a strict timeline and quickly adapt our planning to include these “extras”, keeping in mind that game development is a constant juggle between deadlines and creativity.

That said, while we wouldn’t go as far as defining our development style as a so-called “controlled chaos”, we definitely welcome new, inspiring experiences and allow them to influence our creative process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/3fc22658cf0d4cf081d6599939fdd69759733327.png[/img]

[h3][b]How do you test all these fun things?[/b][/h3]
Videogame Development is a beast that can be faced in very different ways. There are countless creative approaches, but we found that sometimes taking a few steps outside of the “digital” medium is the easiest and most efficient way to tackle certain themes, which was especially true with our Horde Tactics minigame!

Starting with hand-cut pieces of assorted paper and a bunch of fresh ideas on what HordeCore could look like in a tabletop experience, it didn’t take us very long to come up with a fun way to translate the mechanics and theme into a traditional CCG format. We even made some alternative game modes, like “boss hunting” and “2v2”!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/907ec6e42a24b342e200516954d9af86b6e20531.png[/img]

Once we reached something very close to its final iteration, we decided to order a professionally printed CCG set! It was a very amazing tool to get more hands (literally!) on the game so we could “crash-test” the entire experience with our friends, family, and everyone attending our booths in conventions, making the whole process really gratifying. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/f17238cbf027a4da7e1c9687395759fc5881d225.png[/img]

We can’t wait for everyone to get their hands on the full version of the game! It’ll be an exciting journey for sure! 

Don’t forget to add HordeCore to your wishlist, and see you soon!

notes.title: How We Improve Prologue Through User Survey
notes.notes:
Today’s article might be on a more ‘numeric’ side of the gaming industry, but these things are very important and yet are ignored by many. We bet that you already guessed it, but our topic is ‘User Surveys’.
  
While we know that some don’t really like surveys, please bear with us for a bit. While surveys may sometimes have drawbacks (dishonest or inaccurate answers, unclear data, and so on), they are still a very powerful and simple tool, which can immensely help you fine-tune your project. Surveys are also a bit more helpful than reviews, as they are better at pinpointing the problem (not always, but in many cases, they are). 

We in Meta help our developers by implementing user surveys in the free trial versions of our games, such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421970/Time_Loader_First_Memories/]Time Loader: First Memories[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421960/HordeCore_Training_Ground/]HordeCore: Training Ground[/url] (we’ll use that one as an example today). The survey window only appears when the player has either finished the game, quitting it or present as a separate option in the main menu. That's how it looks in HordeCore:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38720297/9e0d96f8c20bc5030eba4356ced2251b6ea06c9a.jpg[/img]

Pretty straightforward, right? We are always giving our players the liberty to decline. After all, not everyone wants to give feedback or spend their time doing surveys, and that’s absolutely fine. Let’s go through a couple of examples to see what questions we ask and what data we get out of the answers ([b]we recommend opening survey images in a new tab[/b]):

[b]Do you like the current weapons variety?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38720297/185d020f607e51928ddca9ea4746d5abd22356b4.png[/img]

At first glance, it might look like everything’s okay, but only a mere 55% of respondents are okay with our arsenal (and that’s a game about shooting!), while 43% of people think that the weapon selection could totally use some work. The interesting thing is that the problem could lie not in the weapon selection itself but in the character interactions. Let’s take a look at another one.

[b]Which characters did you enjoy playing the most?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38720297/4163606e8bcf794311cc033edc8cdaae38807f47.png[/img]

And this is where the problem really hides. Grenadier and Shotgunner were liked by only 4,6% and 3,9% of people respectively, and almost half of them preferred playing as the main (basic) character. Flamer and Gunner sit at ~45%. Looking at the whole picture, you can clearly see that it’s either the character’s design or the game’s balance that is heavily skewed towards using the starting hero and ignoring others. In any case, that area clearly needs some changes. All characters would sit at equal 20% usage in a perfect world, but everyone knows that it’s an impossible feat. So the current objective is to try and make the usage numbers more even than they currently are. 

Now that we have the data, time to act on it. And that’s usually the hardest part because finding a solution to a game design problem isn’t always that simple. 

[b]What did we do with the characters?[/b]
We’ve decided to try a brand new approach and give players more control of the whole group of survivors, instead of focusing on one at a time, by changing our skill system: now you can use all skills ‘within one character’ by pressing dedicated buttons. That way, you lose the need to switch your characters every time you need their skills and at the same time have more control over everything. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38720297/e2eb3e58ca6366b9d6213db9f5a17e54878a546a.gif[/img]

Another thing we’ve added is skill modification. Now you can equip a special item (like Tesla Coil on Engineer) and change your turret from a ranged one to a close-range electric type. That change allows players to fine-tune their abilities and give a lot of space for creativity.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38720297/242ed72d56a7ac758f64874437bed1fb307ea38f.gif[/img]

[b]Did the changes work?[/b]
Absolutely! We did some internal and closed playtests, and the responses have improved immensely. Other characters are no longer collecting dust since you control everyone simultaneously, and the new skill changes make people try and experiment with different set-ups and combinations! We’d say it’s a win-win situation!

As for the weapons, we’ve added a new weapon tier that makes loot hunting a much more rewarding endeavor. While it is a much softer fix than a whole new skill system, we’d like to test them out with new abilities and controls before making more radical changes. 

[b]When will we see some of these new things?[/b]
As soon as they are ready for a public test! We are putting a lot of work into these changes, and we do have plans to update the free version of the game with a preview of new features and mechanics. Not only for everyone’s enjoyment but to also compare previous survey results with the new ones so we can see if our changes really work.

In the end, that’s what surveys are for, and they work best with iterative content. It is a rather simple but very effective method to polish and improve your projects, especially in the early development stages. So don’t be afraid to experiment and ask people what they think about it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421960/HordeCore_Training_Ground/

notes.title: Training Grounds ver.0.12.0.7: Stealth Kills and Graphics Update!
notes.notes:
Good day, survivors! The headquarters have been really busy lately, but we have great news to share: we’ve managed to develop a new way to combat Hordelings! Presenting [b]Version 0.12.0.7,[/b] which adds a brand new game mechanic — Stealth Kills and improves the game’s graphics!

[b]NEW MECHANIC — STEALTH KILLS[/b]
Survivors, check your updated Survival Manual! By approaching Hordelings silently, you can finish them off in one hit without alerting the others! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/fd7fc186cd2cac999edb496c1b0ff689a4b3cfbd.gif[/img]

[b]GRAPHICS UPDATE[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve completely reworked the game’s render module! Expect to see better visual effects and more vivid colours!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38720297/0d35a90c4e4e550be973f794b4ce08ef1f5ccda7.png[/img]

Some people with NVIDIA GPUs can experience a texture bug (all background textures will turn pink). If you encounter this problem, we suggest to do the following:
[list]
[*] Find HordeCore in your Steam Library.
[*] Right-click the game and select "Properties".
[*] In the first tab (GENERAL), under "Launch Options", type or copy and paste the following command: -force-opengl
[*] Play the game!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33940120/9ec4174ceb8e74aa94eded3a3c28f10ef3318672.png[/img]

[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the game’s performance on various PC configs
[*] Fixed the bug, when the game could crash if you were AFK for 15-30 minutes
[*] Resolved the FPS drops on Overpass and Gauntlet levels
[*] Lots of other small fixes
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421960/HordeCore_Training_Ground/

notes.title: Version 0.10.0.14 is Available for Playtest and Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello! 

We are glad to announce that the newest 0.10.0.14 update is already available for both playtest and the demo! Here's a list of changes:

[b]CONTENT[/b]
[list]
[*] A rogue group of Survivors has been spotted hoarding Christmas decorations and hats, so these can no longer be found roaming the wastelands.
[*] After numerous reports of finger injuries due to furious mouse clicking to skip our most extensive dialogs, we have offered our Survivors a free seminar on “How to keep it short and get to the darn point.” Although we’re pretty sure Pyro was paying more attention to how flammable the curtains looked while everyone else took the hint.
[/list]
[b]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Upon reaching one of our vehicle combat levels you’ll now be prompted with a choice of preferred driving keybinds, so, hopefully, we’ll see less traffic collisions and our car insurance company will pick up our calls again someday.
[*] The “Kill’o’meter” has been simplified and will now directly display your XP gains and the percentage of experience achieved towards your next level up.
[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES & OTHER IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Countless bugs have been squashed in the making of this patch, although we found a few new ones crawling under a tree.
[*] Tabbing out of the game will now properly pause the game instead of continuing to chug memory resources.
[*] Several rendering improvements have been made and should improve the game’s overall stability.
[/list]
The update is already available for download! Try restarting your Steam client or verifying game's cache in case you didn't get the download yet. 

Have fun!

notes.title: HordeCore Playtest is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are excited to announce that we are launching Steam Playtest for HordeCore! Steam Playtest is a new feature that'll allow you to participate in the testing of our game completely free! You'll get access to early builds and will be able to leave feedback directly to us, the developers!

[i]A quick reminder about the game: HordeCore is an action side-scroller set in a post-apocalyptic world. Collect unique survivors and strategically pick your team of apocalypse-hardened characters to fight through the unprecedented number of living dead trying to get your brains for a snack. Keep your base camp safe and develop your defenses while growing a community of bad-asses that you can command into the constant fight for survival. Explore the wastelands in search of supplies. Face the unexpected dangers of the apocalyptic world of HordeCore!
[/i]

To participate, just click the button on the game's page. You'll get notified through Steam if you've been selected as one of the game's playtesters. We are inviting everyone to join the testing - it will be fun for both sides!

Don’t forget to click “Follow” on Steam. That way you will get the latest news about the upcoming changes and additions.

notes.title: Let's Play HordeCore Prologue!
notes.notes:
Hello, META gamers! 

We have exciting news from our beloved publisher, META. HordeCore — another game published by them — just received a brand new update for its Prologue and we invite you to check it out!

HordeCore is a kick-ass coop action side-scroller, set in a post-apocalyptic world. You'll fight the Horde - a never-ending stream of [strike]zombies[/strike] undead. The new update brought some neat UI changes and gameplay adjustments to make your experience even better, so now is the perfect time to gather your friends and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421960/HordeCore_Prologue/]join the fight[/url]!

Have fun and stay safe!

notes.title: Greetings, gamers! The Prologue is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Digitality Studios and META Publishing are delighted to announce the release of the HordeCore! Prologue!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421960/HordeCore_Prologue/]HordeCore! Prologue[/url] is a kick-ass action side-scroller set in a post-apocalyptic world. It includes several levels and characters that will be presented at the final game. Moreover, you could already play in COOP using remote control mode and enjoy the game with your friends!

Become the leader of an ever-expanding group of survivors. Manage supplies, upgrade your team, and craft deadly contraptions to defend yourself! Remember, exploration is vital in this harsh new world. Prepare to forge bizarre alliances and, together, face the many dangers of the wastelands. Take survival gameplay, combine it with base management, add RPG elements, and spice it up with a fully-fledged collectible card game - and you get HordeCore!

We hope you'd enjoy playing!
Stay with us for more!

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/bz7cvyT
